notes: Power point plates for splashback cut-outs (BENCH-8; the owner's standard is Schneider Electric / Clipsal, docs/benchtops.md). The cut-out takes the mounting box behind the plate and is hidden by it: the plate less 5 mm each side, our rule. Clipsal publishes no splashback template, so the electrician or fabricator confirms it. Other plates (Saturn, quad) are added here as data. Not verified by a person.
